project(appcompat)
include_directories(${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/dll/appcompat/apphelp)

# sdbinst.exe is all Rust (sdbinst-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/sdbinst-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# sdbinst.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/sdbinst-rust/src/sdbinst/sdbinst.rs)
add_cargo_module(sdbinst sdbinst-cargo sdbinst.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE sdbinst-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32)

include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle
